stem_book: A billiard ball (uniform solid sphere of mass M, radius R) initially at rest is given a sharp blow by a cue stick. The force is horizontal (along +x) and is applied at a distance 2R/3 below the centreline, as shown in figure. The initial speed of the ball is v₀ and the coefficient of kinetic friction is μk. Choose the correct statement(s). (a) Initially kinetic friction acts in −î direction (b) Initially kinetic friction acts in î direction. (c) Ball instantaneously starts pure rolling. (d) Initial angular velocity of ball is 5v₀/(3R)
key: c Ball instantaneously starts pure rolling ⚠
reason: printed key c, but a blow 2R/3 below the centre gives backspin: ω = 5v₀/(3R) and contact speed v₀ + ωR = 8v₀/3 forward ⇒ friction −î (a) and (d) true; instant rolling needs a blow 2R/5 ABOVE the centre
work: Mv₀(2R/3) = (2/5)MR²ω ⇒ ω = 5v₀/(3R) (backspin); v_contact = v₀ + ωR = 8v₀/3 along +x ⇒ kinetic friction along −î
